did: Home had refused the weekly call of November 6 every hour, because its long lists ran past the bottom of the frame once captions took a third of it. A scene too long for the frame now carries on onto more pages, so nothing is cut and the week renders as written, and the check before publishing agrees with what the stage draws, measured in the font home actually uses. Following your direction, a long week is now a series of videos of at most ten minutes each, split at its chapters, with every part saying which part it is, and the routine no longer trims anything to fit.

calls.title: A scene too long for the frame is paged, never cut
options: page it into several scenes, nothing cut
show what fits and count the rest
refuse the week and have the routine trim it
shrink the type until it fits
calls.why: You ruled out editorial cuts and rewriting the week shorter, and paging keeps the template's look.
calls.undo: Draw each scene whole again in the call's code; that brings back the overflow, so pair it with another bound.

calls.title: The fit is measured in the faces the recording hosts draw
options: the widest of Inter and home's WenQuanYi Zen Hei, the face left as it is
ship Inter in the stage so every host draws it
also cover DejaVu Sans, about fifteen percent wider
calls.why: You have no preference over the font, and home is the only renderer; covering a wider face would page weeks that fit at home.
calls.undo: Widen the character widths in the fit model to the faces wanted and rerun its check on each host.

calls.title: A long week is a series of parts derived by code
options: parts derived from one week file, at most ten minutes, split at chapters
the routine writes each part as its own file
one video of any length with a higher cap
calls.why: You asked for several videos of at most eight to ten minutes with nothing cut; deriving them keeps one week file and no schema change.
calls.undo: Drop the parts rule from template version 5 so a week is one video again, or render a week at version 4.

left: The November 6 week renders as three parts only once the render image is republished, the server's half merges, and the week in testing is re-stamped to template version 5; the coordinator is doing those.

A first part can run short, about a minute and a half, when the next chapter can't join it whole; that follows your rule to split at chapters, and it changes if you would rather have short parts filled.
The Rust essay, the engagement report and Playoff Delta have the same unbounded lists and are only guarded late, at the recorder; they are filed as defects.
